title: AI and Workflow Engineer
description: Wego Chemical Group is a global distributor and sourcing partner of chemicals and ingredients. We are an established player in the global specialty chemical markets, providing end-use manufacturers across industries in North America, LATAM, & EMEA with end-to-end supply chain solutions from across the globe. Our team has been operating for over 45 years, serving customers in over 25 countries, with 200+ professionals in 9 offices strategically located across 4 continents. Proudly family-owned and operated, Wego is led by two generations of leadership who bring passion, vision, and a long-term commitment to our partners' success.Job SummaryThe AI and Workflow Engineer is responsible for finding, building, and running AI automation across Wego's business processes. Working in a forward-deployed model, this role sits with business teams to identify the workflows and processes AI can automate, then designs and delivers solutions using Claude, Microsoft Power Automate / Power Platform, and Microsoft Copilot. The role connects the AI stack to Wego's core enterprise systems, including Oracle ERP, Oracle OTM, Salesforce, and SAP Concur, and owns each solution from first prototype through production support.ResponsibilitiesPartner with business teams across Wego to map processes, size transaction volumes, and identify and prioritize AI automation opportunities, starting with quick wins. Design, build, test, and deploy AI agents, workflows, and applications using Claude, Power Automate / Power Platform, and Copilot, selecting the right tool, or combination of tools, for each task. Build and consume REST APIs and webhooks to integrate AI solutions with Oracle ERP, Oracle OTM, Salesforce, SAP Concur, and other business applications. Develop Claude skills, connectors (MCP servers), Cowork tasks, and scheduled tasks for repeatable business workflows. Build event-driven agents that start automatically from system events, such as a new high-priority service ticket, using API triggers, webhooks, the Claude Agent SDK, and Power Automate. Develop applications on the Claude API with structured JSON outputs, using Claude Code as a core development tool. Write and maintain Python or JavaScript services, scripts, and user interfaces, using Git for source control and code reviews. Work with SQL, vector, and graph databases to prepare, store, and retrieve data for AI solutions. Build testing, evaluation, and prompt engineering into every solution to prove accurate output before and after go-live. Monitor token usage, cost per run, and model selection to keep solutions cost-effective. Apply security and governance controls, including least-privilege access, secrets handling, skill vetting, and human approval checkpoints. Work closely with the Enterprise Applications and IT Operations teams on integrations, system changes, and ongoing support. Document designs, procedures, and controls, and train business users on new solutions. Track emerging AI technologies and best practices and share recommendations with IT and business leaders. Key QualificationsBachelor’s degree in computer science, software engineering, information technology, data science, artificial intelligence, or a related field preferred; equivalent hands-on experience will be considered in place of a degree. 2–4 years of hands-on experience building automation, integration, or AI solutions for business users. Track record of shipping AI solutions into production that business users run day to day. Proficiency in Python or JavaScript; working knowledge of HTML and CSS. Strong SQL skills and experience with vector and graph databases. Hands-on experience building and consuming REST APIs and webhooks. Experience building with large language models and generative AI, preferably Claude (Claude API, skills, MCP, Claude Code, Agent SDK). Experience with Microsoft Power Automate / Power Platform and Microsoft Copilot. Understanding of LLM token cost, model selection, and cost optimization. Solid software development fundamentals, including testing, debugging, Git version control, and object-oriented programming. Knowledge of security practices for AI and integrations, including least privilege, secrets management, and human-in-the-loop approval. Experience integrating with ERP or CRM platforms such as Oracle ERP Cloud, Oracle OTM, Salesforce, or SAP Concur preferred. Familiarity with cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, or Google Cloud) preferred. Strong business sense, with the ability to turn a process problem into a practical automation and explain it to non-technical users. Excellent communication skills; self-directed, works well independently and within a team, and is open about skill gaps and how to close them. Location & Work ArrangementGreat Neck, NY (Wego headquarters). Remote work will be considered for a candidate with an excellent fit who is willing to travel to headquarters on an agreed frequency. title: Senior Applied AI Engineer - Artificial Intelligence
description: LocationTorontoBusiness AreaEngineering and CTORef #10053563Description & RequirementsBloomberg’s Engineering AI department has 450+ AI practitioners building highly sought after products and features that often require novel innovations. We are investing in AI to build better search, discovery, and workflow solutions using technologies such as transformers, gradient boosted decision trees, large language models, and dense vector databases. We are expanding our group and seeking highly skilled individuals who will be responsible for contributing to the team (or teams) of Machine Learning (ML) and Software Engineers that are bringing innovative solutions to AI-driven customer-facing products.At Bloomberg, we believe in fostering a transparent and efficient financial marketplace. Our business is built on technology that makes news, research, financial data, and analytics on over 35 million financial instruments searchable, discoverable, and actionable across the global capital markets.Bloomberg has been building Artificial Intelligence applications that offer solutions to these problems with high accuracy and low latency since 2009. We build AI systems to help process and organize the ever-increasing volume of structured and unstructured information needed to make informed decisions. Our use of AI uncovers signals, helps us produce analytics about financial instruments in all asset classes, and delivers clarity when our clients need it most.In Toronto, our Applied AI Engineers are central to Bloomberg's work on financial query understanding, code generation and agentic systems over structured data. They bridge the gap between pioneering research and production, building models and agents that answer complex financial questions, write and execute code, and bring new datasets into the platforms our clients query every day. They engineer state-of-the-art code generation and agent systems, build the evaluation loops that tell us whether those systems are right, and apply LLM techniques like CoT, SFT or RLHF to drive iterative model refinement.Join the AI Department as a Senior Applied AI Engineer and you will have the opportunity to:Collaborate with colleagues on production systems and write, test, and maintain production quality codeDesign, train, experiment, and evaluate ML models, agentic systems, algorithms and solutionsDemonstrate technical leadership by owning cross-team projectsStay current with the latest research in ML/AI and incorporate new findings into our models and methodologiesRepresent Bloomberg at scientific and industry conference and in open-source communitiesPublish product and research findings in documentation, whitepapers or publications to leading academic venuesWe are looking for Senior Applied AI Engineers with the following experience:Ph.D. in Computer Science, AI/ML, NLP or relevant technical field with 0–2 years of experience, or a Master’s with 4+ years, or a Bachelor’s with 5+ years of relevant industry experience. Practical experience applying machine learning, deep learning, and generative AI techniques to real-world problems, from experimentation through production deployment.Strong software engineering skills, including proficiency in Python and experience designing, testing, and maintaining scalable production systems.Hands-on experience building LLM-powered applications, including retrieval-augmented generation, prompt engineering, model evaluation, or post-training techniques.Experience developing agentic AI systems that use external tools, APIs, search systems, databases, or code execution environments.Experience building agentic harnesses or orchestration frameworks, including tool routing, state and memory management, multi-step workflows, guardrails, tracing, retries, and evaluation.Strong computer science fundamentals, communication skills, and the ability to collaborate across technical and non-technical teams; publications at leading AI, ML, or NLP conferences are a plus.If This Sounds Like YouApply if you think we're a good match! We'll get in touch with you to let you know what the next steps are. These automated decisions are made by applying criteria that have been rigorously set by Bloomberg using human input and judgment, and may include communication, decision-making, innovation or teamwork.Discover what makes Bloomberg unique - watch our for an inside look at our culture, values, and the people behind our success.
